description: List the AcroForm fields in a PDF before calling docgen_fill_form. Provide exactly one sourcePdf.base64 or sourcePdf.url; URL sources must be public https serving application/pdf. Returns exact case-sensitive names (including nested names), canonical field types, required flags and options on dropdown, optionList and radioGroup fields. Signature and button entries are discovery only; docgen_fill_form does not sign PDFs or invoke buttons. Does not change the PDF or store a document.

sourcePdf.description: The fillable PDF source — provide exactly ONE of { base64 } or { url }.

base64.description: The source PDF as a base64 string; line breaks/whitespace and an optional `data:application/pdf;base64,` prefix are tolerated. Avoids any network fetch.

url.description: An https URL serving the source PDF. Fetched behind an SSRF guard; must be public and serve application/pdf.

name: docgen_list_form_fields

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_source`: Neither base64 nor url was provided for sourcePdf, or both were. `invalid_pdf_source`: The source is not a valid base64-encoded PDF or valid PDF bytes. `not_a_form`: The source PDF has no AcroForm fields (a flat or XFA-only PDF). `source_unfetchable`: The URL is blocked or did not return a fetchable PDF. `render_timeout`: Inspection exceeded the configured time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fields.description: Every supported AcroForm field; a PDF without fields returns not_a_form.

name.description: Exact case-sensitive AcroForm field name, including any parent path.

options.description: Available choices, present only for dropdown, optionList and radioGroup fields.

required.description: Whether the PDF marks this field as required.

type.description: Canonical field type; signatures and buttons are discovery only.

title: List PDF Form Fields
